result.summary: A residential intersection featuring marked continental crosswalks and sidewalks. While traffic signals are present, the wide roadway and parked vehicles near the crossing create potential visibility and exposure risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the left side of the image may block the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the foreground street, adjacent to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the main roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-specific signals with countdown timers to provide better information to people crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a residential neighborhood with marked continental crosswalks and continuous sidewalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or refuge islands increase exposure for people crossing.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The intersection corners have wide radii that can encourage high-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of visible pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian countdown signals are clearly visible, which can lead to uncertainty for pedestrians regarding the remaining crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers and a Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI) to give pedestrians a head start.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Pedestrian Exposure
hazards.description: The wide turning radius and lack of curb extensions increase the distance pedestrians must travel in the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility marked crosswalk and a sidewalk in good condition, supported by a traffic signal and a 'No Turn on Red' restriction. However, the wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians without a refuge island or visible pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large tree on the corner may partially obscure pedestrians from approaching drivers or block sightlines for those waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the crosswalk entrance

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.
